25499.d: Graafiline leht metsast lookleva ojaga, mis esiplaanil laieneb tiigiks. Pildi keskel on tiigikaldal lahtiriietunult kaks naist suplema minemas. Heledapäine naine, kelle juuksed on pärlitega läbipõimitud, katab rinda looriga, istudes parem jalg vees, teine toetub kaldal asuvale murule ja vaatab hirmunult paremale. Tumedapäine naine kannab keerulist soengut, kummardub kaaslase poole ja vaatab samuti hirmunult paremale. Ta seisab vees ja toetab pahema põlvega kaldal asuvale kivile. Paremalt, metsast tuleb välja sokujalgne sarvedega satüür, pilk suplejail.(eesti)
25499.de: A print depicting a forest with a meandering stream, which widens into a pond in the foreground. In the middle of the picture, on the bank of the pond, two undressed women are about to go bathing. The fair-haired woman, whose hair is interwoven with pearls, covers her breast with a veil, sitting with her right leg in the water, while the other leans on the grass by the bank and looks fearfully to the right. The dark-haired woman wears an elaborate hairstyle, bends towards her companion and also looks fearfully to the right. She stands in the water and rests her left knee on a stone on the bank. From the right, out of the forest, comes a satyr with goat legs and horns, his gaze on the bathers.
